rule: Method: `Type#member`. | Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium). | `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`.
notes: The method receiver s is a parameter of declared type *Service, so s.validate is Service#validate (the Go form of a call on the enclosing type). s.repo.Save is an obj.field chain whose field repo has declared type *Repo (decision A); the pointer names the pointee (Decisions 2026-10-29), so Repo#Save. Locals declared with `var s Service` / `var r Repo` are typed by their declaration. Pointer receivers do not appear in IDs.
